newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Sungei Way Holdings to list unit stock.
newsitem.headline: Sungei Way Holdings to list unit stock.

text.p: Sungei Way Holdings Bhd said on Tuesday it expected to list its subsidiary, Sungei Way Construction Bhd, on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange's main board in the first quarter next year.
The national Bernama news agency quoted Sungei Way Holdings managing director Tan Kia Loke as saying approval for the listing had been received from the Securities Commission (SC).
DCB Sakura Merchant Bankers Bhd has been appointed adviser for the listing exercise, Tan told reporters on Tuesday.
DCB Sakura managing director Heah Sieu Lay said preparations for the listing were in the final stages, but declined to elaborate.
Tan said Sungei Way Holdings' equity in the wholly owned Sungei Way Construction would be reduced to 60 percent after the listing. Sungei Way is Malaysia's largest quarry operator.
He said the listing would enable Sungei Way Construction to tap funds from the capital market and further expand its rapidly growing business.
Sungei Way Construction is involved mainly in building construction and civil works in large infrastructure projects. Tan said it had secured contracts worth nearly 3.0 billion ringgit.
